script_text: Stop, Aquarius: your air-sign brilliance is being tested by a financial reality check. Saturn in your 2nd House is squaring Uranus, your ruling planet, in the 5th House, so a pleasure, romance, or creative gamble may collide with rent, debt, or a budget line. Mercury retrograde in Gemini is also conjunct Uranus, sharpening your intuition but making texts, contracts, and old flames replay fast. If single, you attract an electric, unconventional person through a message or social app, but don't confuse chemistry with commitment. If taken, watch a jealousy flare around shared plans. Career-wise, Jupiter entering your 6th House sextiles Neptune in the 3rd House, opening a paid collaboration, wellness role, or client lead through a neighbor, sibling, or short trip. Avoid signing anything before you reread the fine print twice. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week, Aquarius.
